exposure: Shaggy dog appearance of the uterine serosa on MRI
Reader experience (10, 5, and 2 years of experience)
outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of MRI criteria for placental adhesion disorder
cohort: 28 women, 18 with placental adhesion disorders (PAD) and 10 without PAD.
finding: Dark intraplacental bands on T2-weighted MRI were the most sensitive, specific, and reproducible criterion for diagnosis of PAD.
